name: Deliver Information 23
definition: Parameters applied to the settlement of a security transfer.

Transferor.name: Transferor
Transferor.definition: Party that delivers (transferor) securities to the receiving agent (transferee).

TransferorRegisteredAccount.name: Transferor Registered Account
TransferorRegisteredAccount.definition: Account from which the securities are to be delivered.

IntermediaryInformation.name: Intermediary Information
IntermediaryInformation.definition: Identification of a related party or intermediary.

SecuritiesForm.name: Securities Form
SecuritiesForm.definition: Form, that is, ownership, of the security, that is, registered or bearer.

DematerialisedIndicator.name: Dematerialised Indicator
DematerialisedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a security exists only as an electronic record, that is, there is no physical document representing the security.

IncomePreference.name: Income Preference
IncomePreference.definition: Dividend option chosen by the account owner based on the options offered in the prospectus.

BeneficiaryCertificationCompletion.name: Beneficiary Certification Completion
BeneficiaryCertificationCompletion.definition: Beneficial owner or its designated agent certifies that it complies with any holding or investment restrictions or requirements of the fund.

RequestedTradeDate.name: Requested Trade Date
RequestedTradeDate.definition: Date used as the trade date when securities are settled through an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) or Central Securities Depository (CSD).

RequestedSettlementDate.name: Requested Settlement Date
RequestedSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be exchanged at the International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) or Central Securities Depository (CSD).

EffectiveSettlementDate.name: Effective Settlement Date
EffectiveSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities were exchanged at the International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) or Central Securities Depository (CSD).

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money paid/to be paid or received in exchange for the financial instrument.

StampDuty.name: Stamp Duty
StampDuty.definition: Specifies if the settlement amount includes the stamp duty amount.

Fees.name: Fees
Fees.definition: Fee related to the transfer of the financial instrument.

IndividualTax.name: Individual Tax
IndividualTax.definition: Tax related to the transfer of a financial instrument.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.|How the exchange rate is expressed determines which currency is the Unit Currency and Quoted Currency. If the amounts concerned are EUR 1000 and USD 1300, the exchange rate may be expressed as per either of the following examples:|EXAMPLE 1 |UnitCurrency EUR|QuotedCurrency USD|ExchangeRate 1.300|EXAMPLE 2|UnitCurrency USD|QuotedCurrency EUR|ExchangeRate 0.769.

SettlementPartiesDetails.name: Settlement Parties Details
SettlementPartiesDetails.definition: Chain of parties involved in the settlement of the transaction.

PhysicalTransfer.name: Physical Transfer
PhysicalTransfer.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument is to be physically delivered.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of the transfer. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the transfer as assigned by the underlying client.

PhysicalTransferDetails1Rule.definition: If PhysicalTransfer is PHYS (Physical), then PhysicalTransferDetails must be present.

PhysicalTransferDetails2Rule.definition: If PhysicalTransfer is DEMT (Dematerialised), then PhysicalTransferDetails is not allowed.
